text:
racheal_cs: Heads-up — I'm drafting a pocket ops playbook CSMs can hand to customers during onboarding and pre-renewal checks. Goal: reduce renewal risk by standardizing prefill/delta-sync, caching, batching, and streaming best-practices. Need quick checklist + owners.
anya_csm: love this. Can we make it a 1-page checklist + two example configs? CSMs just want copy-paste action items. :100: 
racheal_cs: thinking header sections: health signals, prefill cadence, delta-sync windowing, recommended cache TTLs, batch size heuristics, streaming fallback options, feedback hooks.
tom_eng: include a tiny prefill job example and a curl to turn on streaming in the client SDK. Keep it tiny.
liam_sre: also add SLO note: if interactive p50 >300ms, prefer smaller batches or enable prefix-KV cache.
anya_csm: draft checklist: 1) Account health snapshot 2) Prefill run 24h before launch 3) Warm pools enabled 4) Delta-sync 5–10m 5) Fallback: cached response or smaller model.
racheal_cs: owners: CSM runs health snapshot; Eng provides prefill template; SRE owns warm pools & latency thresholds; CSM captures feedback.
tom_eng: minimal prefill snippet (for customers):
```yaml
# prefill-job.yaml
job: prefill_v1
schedule: "24h-before-launch"
requests:
  - prompt_set: tenant_warmup
  - concurrency: 4
  - max_tokens: 256
  - cache_policy: prefix
  - cache_ttl_secs: 86400
```
anya_csm: add delta-sync example for event-driven updates (recommend 5–10m depending on traffic).
liam_sre: delta-sync note: use idempotent updates and low-cardinality keys; if deltas >50kb, switch to chunking + streaming.
tom_eng: streaming tips: enable chunked responses, keepalive 30s, server short-circuit if generation >1.2s.
anya_csm: feedback capture: quick survey after first five live requests: "Did the response match expectations?" store in support ticket and tag by prompt set.
onboard-bot: Reminder scheduled: send playbook draft to #customer-success-docs in 24h.
racheal_cs: next steps: Tom — shorten YAML + add curl snippet; Liam — add one-line latency/fallback thresholds; Anya — format 1-pager and include feedback hook text.
anya_csm: I'll prep two templated emails: (1) pre-launch enablement checklist, (2) renewal-risk touchpoint email with health snapshot.
tom_eng: curl example for enabling streaming to include:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sessions/stream -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"open-llm-3","stream":true,"keepalive":30}'
```
liam_sre: escalation: if renewal risk score >0.7 AND avg latency rising, schedule 30-min triage with ENG+SRE+CSM.
racheal_cs: assembling and will drop into #customer-success-docs for review. thanks all :thumbsup: 
anya_csm: will pilot with two customers this week and report back.
onboard-bot: Thread closed automatically after 72h unless replied to.
